description: The full record for named style props: the CSS they write, every value they accept, and a measured example — plus, for a numeric prop, the scale measured at 1/2/4/8, because the dividers differ per prop (235 props in all). Nesting keys are answered here too: hover, focus, focusVisible, hasFocus, active, valid, hasValid, invalid, hasInvalid, optional, hasChecked, hasRequired, hasDisabled, visited, target, open, placeholderShown, autofill, inRange, outOfRange, inert, rtl, ltr, indeterminate, checked, required, disabled, selected, before, after, placeholder, selection, marker, firstLine, firstLetter, backdrop, fileButton, sm, md, lg, xl, xxl, pointerCoarse, pointerFine, motionReduce, forcedColors, contrastMore, cq, dataAttr, ariaAttr, has, not, nth, group, peer, theme, startingStyle.
name: get_props
title: Box style props
